title: Digits on a roll
description: Individual digits take the shortest path around a spring-driven number wheel.
useCase: Show occasional changes in a small metric, score or count.
reducedMotion: Digits change immediately to their target. Only the target count is exposed to assistive technology.
limitations: This compact sample is a three-digit integer counter. Add explicit sign, decimal and digit-count handling for other data.
look: Large regular-weight slate-teal numerals with a small grey unit label on a pale blue-grey page, above a hairline rule and a small refresh icon.
motion: Pressing refresh changes the count and each digit column rolls vertically through intermediate numerals on a firm, non-bouncy spring (stiffness 280, damping 22, mass 0.3).
adapt: `Digit` drives a `useSpring` (stiffness 280, damping 22, mass 0.3) per place and `NumberRow` wraps each numeral's `y` with `useTransform`; `canAnimate` falls back to `jump`. Replace `values` and the `[100, 10, 1]` place list for other digit counts.
